inputs.original_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law, arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The claim, brought by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, argued that an Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” Judge Christina R. [...] The post This Judge Thinks Killing Babies in Abortions is a Religious Right appeared first on LifeNews.com .
inputs.modified_text: An Indiana judge has blocked an abortion restriction after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued it interfered with people’s ability to live by their sincerely held religious beliefs. This is about more than religious freedom: it’s a reminder that the state should not dictate people’s reproductive choices or make access to care depend on their resources. The burden of these restrictions falls hardest on people with the least room to absorb it. LifeNews.com’s “killing babies” framing obscures the real issue—who gets to make decisions about their bodies and beliefs.
